proofClass: fail-closed exact identity and quantitative inertia gate

requiredFields.J: exact zeta/Weil pullback with source, target, and closure topology
requiredFields.B: complete endpoint, primitive-prefix, completion, and theta-tail terms

augmentedReplacementInputStatus.label: augmented H8 replacement theorem
augmentedReplacementInputStatus.reason: The coercive replacement is valid but explicitly has no original-Weyl or RH implication by itself.

refutedOriginalPremiseAcknowledgedStatus.label: original endpoint-B premise is acknowledged as refuted
refutedOriginalPremiseAcknowledgedStatus.reason: The transfer may not reuse or rename the disproved nonnegativity premise.

preciseZetaWeilPullbackStatus.label: precise zeta/Weil pullback J and its domain
preciseZetaWeilPullbackStatus.reason: J must be defined as an exact operator on a specified zeta test space, not inferred from finite kernel matches.

exactDomainClosureStatus.label: source/target domains and closure topologies match exactly
exactDomainClosureStatus.reason: Trace-range density and entrywise kernel convergence do not establish H8 pullback closure.

regularizerAccountingStatus.label: added H8 regularizer is exactly identified and subtracted
regularizerAccountingStatus.reason: Every L2 and derivative term added to a_rep must be transported and accounted for on range J.

boundaryTailAccountingStatus.label: all boundary and tail terms are exact
boundaryTailAccountingStatus.reason: No endpoint, primitive-prefix, theta-tail, or completion term may be hidden in wrapper flags.

exactAugmentedToZetaIdentityStatus.label: W_zeta=a_rep[Jx]-R[Jx]+B(x)
exactAugmentedToZetaIdentityStatus.reason: The identity closes only after the operator, domain, regularizer, and boundary/tail obligations all close.

negativeDirectionReachabilityStatus.label: certified negative direction is reachable or exactly excluded
negativeDirectionReachabilityStatus.reason: The current reachability audit is unresolved in the H8 transfer topology.

quantitativeInertiaStatus.label: finite-height negative-index bound and asymptotic passage
quantitativeInertiaStatus.reason: A signed form requires a quantitative inertia theorem rather than an all-or-nothing positivity wrapper.

concreteZetaConclusionStatus.label: specific unconditional zeta conclusion
concreteZetaConclusionStatus.reason: Closure requires an explicit zero-location or zero-proportion theorem, not an internal form statement.

remainingAnalyticGap: Exact J/domain identity, negative-direction reachability, quantitative inertia, and a concrete unconditional zeta conclusion are not all closed.
nonImplication: The coercive augmented-form theorem alone does not imply original Weil positivity, a zero proportion, or RH.
